# Amazon Route 53 Resolver

Store Resolver endpoints, rules and VPC associations as records without allocating network interfaces or forwarding DNS queries.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Service ID | `route53resolver` |

| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |

| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 17 of 72 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-route-53-resolver) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No DNS forwarding, recursive resolution, network interfaces, IP allocation or runtime; OPERATIONAL/COMPLETE are metadata status values.
- Only IPv4 INBOUND/OUTBOUND endpoints and FORWARD/SYSTEM rules; INBOUND_DELEGATION, DELEGATE, IPv6, protocols and advanced settings are excluded.
- Endpoint IP configuration count follows the pinned model (2–20); only endpoint Name can be updated, and ListResolverEndpointIpAddresses is excluded.
- List filters, autodefined Internet Resolver rules and AWS-managed RECURSIVE rules are excluded.
- No DNS Firewall, query logging, Outposts, Resolver/DNSSEC configuration or rule sharing policies.
- CloudFormation rejects endpoint IpAddresses and Tags updates and removal of endpoint Name or rule Name/TargetIps/ResolverEndpointId; immutable changes use replacement.
- CloudFormation endpoint/rule Ref returns the resource ID used by their primary identifier; association Ref returns its association ID.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
